description:
Run the pinned resumable campaign and commit its versioned evidence receipt with a concise provenance record.

## Background

The scientific target is the pinned Fossorier 1994 dissertation series [Fossorier1994] for eBCH $(128,64)$ on BI-AWGN/BPSK: order-2 BER versus $E_b/N_0$, with order 1 as an explicitly internal control. The Fossorier1995 article is closed-access and recorded as unverified. Measurements remain valid or falsifying according to confidence intervals and recorded protocol identity.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The committed receipt records seeds, git revision, toolchain, hardware, configuration, per-cell counts, work counters, termination, and binomial confidence intervals.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each matched order-2 point accepts its published value $p$ exactly when $p \in [L-\delta, U+\delta]$, where $[L, U]$ is the receipt interval at its recorded method and level and $\delta$ the recorded digitization precision, without converting discrepancies into silent retuning.
- [hard] REQ-03: Order-1 results are identified as campaign controls rather than externally sourced claims.
- [hard] REQ-04: Interrupted, censored, or budget-exhausted cells remain visible and resumable without repeated completed work.
- [hard] REQ-05: The provenance note identifies contradictory evidence and the exact receipt schema version.
title: eBCH OSD curve reproduction
